newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts Elscint EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts Elscint EPS.

text.p: Lehman Brothers cut its 1997 earnings per share estimate for Elscint Ltd following weaker than expected first quarter results for the Israeli company.

Lehman analyst Ted Kundtz said in a report released on Sunday that he was lowering his 1997 estimate to $0.39 from $0.55. In 1996 Elscint, which manufactures diagnostic imaging equipment, earned $0.51 a share.

"The loss for the first quarter, which amounted to $0.05 per share versus a $0.16 per share profit a year ago, was due in large part to an exchange loss resulting from the strengthening of the U.S. dollar relative to the European currencies," the report said.
System sales were weaker in the first quarter due to lower dollar sales of computerised tomography equipment though unit volume rose.
The new estimate assumes no growth in overall revenues in 1997, Kundtz said.

"While Elscint does not expect additional significant exchange losses in 1997, we believe earnings over the next three quarters will be below our earlier projections due to the likelihood of weaker sales," he said.
